sections.description:
🚀 Transform Your Email Quality with AI-Powered Validation

Tired of fake emails, spam traps, and disposable addresses cluttering your database? DeBounce Email Validator is the ultimate solution for WordPress websites that demand real, deliverable email addresses.

Why Choose DeBounce?
* 99.9% Accuracy Rate – Industry-leading validation precision
* Zero IP Impact – No emails sent, no blacklisting risk
* GDPR Compliant – Complete privacy protection
* Real-time Validation – Instant feedback for users
* Advanced AI Detection – Catches sophisticated spam attempts

Perfect for:
* E-commerce stores (WooCommerce)
* Lead generation forms
* User registration systems
* Contact forms
* Newsletter signups
* Any WordPress form

Simply install, connect your API key, and watch your email quality soar while reducing spam and improving conversion rates.

SUPPORTED FORMS AND PLUGINS

Universal WordPress Integration – Works with any form that uses WordPress’s is_email() function, plus dedicated support for popular plugins:

E-commerce & Business Forms

  • WooCommerce – Validate shipping and billing emails
  • Gravity Forms – Enterprise-grade form validation
  • Contact Form 7 – Most popular contact form plugin
  • WPForms – Drag & drop form builder

Advanced Form Builders

  • Ninja Forms – Professional form creation
  • Formidable Forms – Complex form solutions
  • Forminator – Modern form builder
  • Fluent Forms – Advanced form management
  • Elementor Forms – Page builder integration
  • WSForms – Premium form builder

WordPress Core Features

  • WordPress Comments – Validate commenter emails
  • User Registration – Ensure valid signup emails
  • Jetpack Forms – Automattic’s form solution

Custom Integration

  • Any Custom Form – Works with is_email() function
  • Third-party Plugins – Automatic compatibility
  • API Integration – Direct API access available

No Code Changes Required – Simply activate and configure!

KEY FEATURES

Advanced Email Validation Engine – Powered by DeBounce’s industry-leading API with comprehensive validation checks:

🔍 Core Validation Checks

  • DNS & MX Record Validation – Verify domain authenticity
  • Syntax Verification – IETF/RFC standard compliance
  • Mailbox Existence – Confirm email actually exists
  • SMTP Connection Testing – Real server verification

🛡️ Security & Spam Protection

  • Disposable Email Detection – Block temporary email services
  • Spam Trap Identification – Prevent honeypot emails
  • Typosquatting Prevention – Catch misspelled domains
  • Role-based Email Filtering – Block info@, admin@, etc.
  • Custom Blocklist – Your own domain/email restrictions

⚡ Performance & Reliability

  • Real-time Validation – Instant user feedback
  • Temporary Unavailability Detection – Handle server issues
  • Catch-All Domain Testing – Identify low-quality domains
  • Greylisting Detection – Advanced spam protection
  • 99.9% Accuracy Rate – Industry-leading precision

🔒 Privacy & Compliance

  • GDPR Compliant – No email storage
  • Zero IP Impact – No emails sent from your servers
  • Secure API Communication – Encrypted data transfer
  • Privacy-First Design – Your data stays private

📊 Analytics & Monitoring

  • Validation Logs – Track all validation attempts
  • Performance Metrics – Monitor validation success rates
  • Custom Error Messages – Branded user feedback
  • Multi-language Support – Global accessibility

sections.faq:
How does this WordPress plugin work?

The WordPress plugin uses DeBounce API to validate emails directly from your WordPress website. Using this plugin, you will never have invalid emails in your database. It works with all the registration and contact forms.

Does email validation affect my IP reputation?

DeBounce doesn’t send any emails to the recipient’s address during the validation process. All processing is done on its servers, so your IP addresses and domains are not affected in any way by the DeBounce service. This means that your IP or domains never get blacklisted, since the plugin never uses them.

Does this plugin store email addresses?

DeBounce really cares about data protection and user privacy and never store any emails called from API.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

DeBounce really cares about data protection and user privacy and never store any emails called from API. For more information, please read the following links:
* DeBounce GDPR Compliancy
* DeBounce Privacy Policy

**💰 Pricing & Credits**

How much does it cost?

Start with 100 free validations to test the service. Paid plans start at $0.003 per validation with volume discounts available. View pricing details

What happens when I run out of credits?

You can choose to either consider all emails valid or block all submissions. This is configurable in the plugin settings.

Can I get a refund if I’m not satisfied?

Yes, DeBounce offers a money-back guarantee. If you’re not satisfied, contact support for a full refund.

**⚡ Performance & Reliability**

How fast is the validation?

Validation typically completes in under 1 second with real-time user feedback. The plugin includes configurable timeout settings for optimal performance.

What’s the accuracy rate?

DeBounce achieves 99.9% accuracy through advanced AI-powered validation and comprehensive checking algorithms.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes.

**🔧 Integration & Support**

Which forms are supported?

Works with all major WordPress form plugins including WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, WPForms, and any custom form using is_email().

Do I need coding knowledge?

No coding required! Simply install, activate, add your API key, and select which forms to protect. The plugin handles everything automatically.

What if I need help?

DeBounce provides excellent support through their help center, email support, and comprehensive documentation. Most users get up and running in under 5 minutes.
